proposals.evidence: Full parṇa subsection 1 documents ordinary leaf forms Punjabi pannā, Nepali pānu, Marwari/Gujarati/Marathi pān and Gujarati pā̃dṛũ leaf with a consonantal extension. It explicitly gives reduced Kalasha pᵘŕə̃/pŕũ through a proposed puṇ stage. These support the selected nasal leaf forms and western consonant-extended family members. Source nasal place, retroflexion, aspiration, vowels and final inflection remain unchanged. The western ṭ/ḍ/ṭh variations are provisional regional-family assignments, not a newly reconstructed ancient suffix or settled sound law; local development and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. Ordinary leaf is distinguished from the separate pārṇa/betel-leaf discussion. Exact response: pānaḍu.
